name: @guardbee/mcp-audit-gap-auditor
description: MCP server that audits MCP server source for OWASP MCP08:2025 (Lack of Audit and Telemetry) — missing tool-call logging, raw args/results in logs, disabled audit sinks, and tool errors swallowed without a record
long_description: OWASP MCP08:2025 calls out missing audit and telemetry as a top MCP risk: without a durable record of tool invocations, incident response is blind. This package statically scans TypeScript and Python MCP server source for servers that register tools but never log them, logs that dump raw tool args or results (secret leakage), hard-disabled audit/telemetry flags, silent catch blocks around tool handlers, and audit events that omit a session or request correlation id. Complements @guardbee/mcp-security-proxy, which supplies a hash-chained gateway audit trail when the upstream server cannot. No API key required — runs entirely locally.
